content: Okay so update on the ukulele: I can now play a song that is ALMOST recognizable. My neighbor knocked on the wall but I'm choosing to believe it was applause. What should I learn next?
I went down a rabbit hole about lighthouses last night. Did you know some of them had keepers who lived there for decades? I would last about three days before talking to the seagulls. Maybe two.
Hot take incoming: socks with sandals are actually great and the world is not ready to hear it. Comfort over fashion. Fight me. Gently.
I reorganized my entire bookshelf by color and now I can't find anything, but it looks AMAZING. Worth it? Discuss.
So there's this tiny café near me that does a different pastry every day and today's was some kind of cardamom swirl thing and I think I saw the face of the universe. Anyway, how's your day going?
I've been trying to learn to whistle with two fingers. Current status: lots of spit, zero whistle. Any tips? Please. My dignity depends on it.
You know when you find a song you love and you listen to it 40 times in a row until you hate it? I'm on listen 32. Pray for me.
Thinking about getting into birdwatching. I already know pigeons and 'the loud one'. Starting strong.
My plant finally grew a new leaf after four months of nothing. I threw it a small party. Just me. And the plant. It was nice.
I tried a new route on my walk and found a little free library with a book about the history of buttons. BUTTONS. I took it. No regrets.
Rainy day today and honestly I love it. Blanket, tea, a podcast about shipwrecks. Perfect. What would your perfect rainy day be?
I've decided I'm going to learn one fun fact per day. Today's: wombat poop is cube-shaped. You're welcome. Tomorrow's will be classier. Maybe.
Had the weirdest dream where I was a contestant on a cooking show but every ingredient was a different kind of cheese. I won. Obviously.
I attempted to make bread. It's less 'bread' and more 'decorative doorstop'. But I learned things! Mostly about failure.
I just realized I've been pronouncing 'quinoa' wrong my whole life and now I don't know who I am.
Okay I need your opinion: is it acceptable to name a houseplant something extremely formal, like Reginald? Because I just did.
There's a squirrel outside my window that I'm 90% sure is the same one every day. I've named him Gerald. Gerald and I have an understanding.
I spent twenty minutes today trying to figure out which way a fitted sheet goes. I won, but at what cost.
Learned a new card game this weekend and I am DOMINATING. Like, dangerously good. Should I go pro? Kidding. Mostly.
Today I discovered that if you hum while you vacuum, it's basically a concert. The acoustics are incredible.
Do you ever get the urge to learn something completely random? Mine this week is juggling. I have three oranges and a dream.
I finally watched the sunrise on purpose. Woke up at 5 like a lunatic. It was gorgeous though. Totally worth the grumpiness.
Okay random question: if you had to live inside a painting, which would you pick? I'm torn between something cozy and something with a lot of ocean.
I made a playlist called 'songs to dramatically stare out a window to'. It's very good. 10/10 for window staring.
I found my old tamagotchi in a drawer. It's been dead for fifteen years. I feel weirdly guilty.
I accidentally sent a voice memo to the wrong group chat and it was just me singing to my plant. Mortifying. Anyway.
New goal: make my bed every morning for a month. Day 1 complete. I'm basically a new person.
